title: PF2e Flatten Proficiency Level bonus for PCs and NPCs (Unofficial v14 test candidate)
description: Unofficial modified v14 test candidate derived from PF2e Flatten 0.6.2. Runtime compatibility is unverified. Applies the original custom modifier to NPCs and optionally PCs for full or half-level proficiency reduction. See CHANGELOG.md and NOTICE for modification and attribution details.
